listing.name: Shin Megami Tensei NINE — SMT NINE Recomp (gymzatan)
listing.summary: The project tested startup, save/load, movies, streets and shops, story battles, RTS tutorials and entry into chapter 2. It explicitly does not guarantee a full playthrough or stable 60 FPS. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese retail Xbox disc as ISO, XISO or a complete extracted default.xbe and Media folder. The default.xbe SHA256 is 6c249401369ed41c2a319762f0b56b80aefde3efe766ac0d8731889a4150deac; the project provides a complete 3515-file manifest. Chinese translation is optional. Import a separately patched English ISO only after the initial Japanese build.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source with setup.cmd and build.cmd on Windows using Python3.14, VS2022 and Rustup. Release assets update an existing installation; they are not initial game packages.

warnings: The project tested startup, save/load, movies, streets and shops, story battles, RTS tutorials and entry into chapter 2. It explicitly does not guarantee a full playthrough or stable 60 FPS.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
